description: ACORD-aligned entity and relationship dictionary for Lloyd's Market Reform Contract (MRC v3) extraction

Broker.description: The intermediary arranging the insurance placement

Insurer.description: The underwriter or syndicate providing coverage

Limit.description: The maximum amount payable under the policy

Deductible.description: The amount the insured must bear before coverage applies

Clause.description: A contractual clause included in the policy wording

Exclusion.description: A specific peril or circumstance excluded from coverage

Premium.description: The price charged for insurance coverage

PLACED_BY.description: The broker who placed the risk in the market

ISSUED_TO.description: The insured party on the policy

HAS_LIMIT.description: Coverage limit attached to the policy

CONTAINS_CLAUSE.description: A clause forming part of the policy wording

EXCLUDES.description: A peril or circumstance excluded from coverage

HAS_PREMIUM.description: The premium charged for the policy
